title: PermissionRule
description: `GET /permission-rules/:ruleId`, `POST /permission-rules`, `DELETE /permission-rules/:ruleId` and `PATCH /permission-rules/:ruleId`: one rule, whatever its state — the same shape as one entry of `PermissionRuleList.rules`, named again rather than declared twice (plan 28, B-48). `PATCH` shortens or extends `expiresAt` alone (plan 15, B-12, D-01) — no other field of a rule is ever edited.
